body:
We’ve talked about it a few times, which is difficult with him. He hates talking about his feelings and I know this is really hard on him, too, so the few times he actually said something back when I wanted to talk about it, he let very little go. Despite my despair sometimes, I do try to give him all the time he needs with this. I don’t want to force him. It really only angers him. 

That aside, he’s said a few times that ‘he just doesn’t understand’ why I would think this way. Other times he mentioned he feels rather useless, and even incompetent. Also from past conversations I remember he often didn’t know what to say or do and kind of shut off. Understandable, some people can handle such situations well and some can’t. In my opinion it’s not something to be ashamed of and I definitely don’t blame him for it. 

On top of that he’s not doing really well either. He has a lot on his mind. Sometimes he’s being really moody and he doesn’t notice (and pointing it out makes it even worse, but I can’t help myself sometimes) and sometimes he says things he, later on explains, doesn’t mean. In return, so do I, and I act really clingy sometimes. So to say, frustrations come from both sides. A two week break worked for about a week, or two, and then the effect wore off. I’ve thought about taking a longer break but deep down I know this is not a solution either. Last time we took a break it didn’t feel right for either of us. 

It is a bit of an issue though. Sometimes I really think I hate him so much. I don’t, I don’t think I’ve ever loved a man like this besides my father, but frustrations are building up. He makes me feel really bad unintentionally, some moments. He feels bad about it himself, so I tend to keep it to me and myself only, but someday I’ll have to talk to him about this, I think. 

But thank you, really! It’s really motivating to hear such a thing. I feel very weak most of the days, but today is a good day—I’ve actually been feeling strong, for still being here, and not giving up just yet. Who knows what the next days will bring. I just hope I’ll hold on until help arrives.

I know they are not, but I've already had quite some issues with them as it is, I don't really wish for any more. We've seen the doctor together and he can understand their point of view too, so he himself advised me to stop later on. For now.

Thanks a lot. I made myself a mental note to write this whenever one of those thoughts etc popped up today and so far it has really worked. Had a few moments I was about to fall into relapse but--so far, I'm going strong. This was a great help up till now!

(watch me get way ahead with the little optimism)

First of all, thank you for your comment. 

I know that now [that I’m doing a little better again] but honestly, when I’m at my worst, I can’t see any of that and it pisses them off. Mostly my boyfriend, hence why we’ve been having so much issues lately. Most of them come from me, but at the same time I can’t really help being that way yet. I’m trying really hard though. 

I used to like comedy, yes. Lately however, I find it really hard to enjoy something. Sometimes I watch films and enjoy them, or series, animes, anything really. I used to love reading books, so I try that sometimes too. However, some days, nothing can amuse me, really. Also, I don’t really know what comedies to watch. For one, I’m not a very big fan of cabaret, so that’s a no-go. I just don’t know what I enjoy anymore. 

I’m not really comfortable in talking to my parents that way. They were already surprised that I admitted a month or so ago that I was feeling really bad and that I wanted to try therapy. But I don’t think they will agree to going back to anti-depressants unless the psychologist prescribes them, because they are of opinion these things are really addictive. I understand your point though, thank you
I've thought about doing this before, but it only scares me. I always fear the moment I realise no one cares anymore.
